decisions.reason: Transactional email is very close to the firm's established enterprise messaging capabilities, and its home-page prominence suggests enough strategic value and learning potential to continue refining it rather than exit.

Document capture and recognition is somewhat less central than core messaging services, but the dedicated page and cited customer use indicate credible demand that the firm can build on through adjacent knowledge and further development.
Email and fax conversion fits tightly with the firm's existing know-how in business communication infrastructure, so absorptive capacity is high and the product is likely worth retaining.
Fax delivery optimization is highly related to the firm's legacy fax and routing expertise, making it easy to understand, improve, and commercialize as part of the core offer.

Email sandbox threat protection is adjacent to the firm's email security activities and therefore still within reach of its knowledge base, though the earlier disappearance of another security product makes this line somewhat more exposed than the messaging products.
